taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-13, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-13, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station T-13, Survey Area T**

The VES interpretation at T-13 resolves five layers with resistivity increasing monotonically with depth:

- Layer 1: 1340.2 Ω·m (0–1.08 m)
- Layer 2: 2148.3 Ω·m (1.08–2.46 m)
- Layer 3: 5322.7 Ω·m (2.46–3.72 m)
- Layer 4: 18475.7 Ω·m (3.72–4.05 m)
- Layer 5: 19320.3 Ω·m (basement, no lower boundary)

Checking each three-layer window: r1<r2<r3 (A) for layers 1-2-3, again A for 2-3-4, and again A for 3-4-5. All three letters are identical, so the curve is uniformly type A (AAA = A), consistent with a resistivity profile that increases steadily with depth and no intervening low-resistivity layer.

This matches the on-file classification of A-type for this station; no discrepancy is found between the computed curve type and the filed label.

{"curve_type_stated": "AAA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
